name: The Red Sea EDITION
positioning: EDITION resort on Shura Island within the Red Sea Project, with a Bali-inspired beach club, a spa and a fitness-focused programme
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort with a spa and active wellness classes
Guests who like a lively beach club and varied dining on site

facts.text: The Red Sea EDITION is on Shura Island within the Red Sea Project in Saudi Arabia.
Central is a restaurant that nods to New York City's Grand Central Station and serves American classics and comfort food.
The spa performs Omorovicza signature rituals.
The gym has Technogym equipment, a martial arts studio and reformer Pilates.
Some suites have private outdoor pools and showers.
Guest rooms have views to the sea or the golf course.
The hotel has an infinity pool with Red Sea views and a private beach with cabanas.
The hotel has tennis and paddle courts, a volleyball court and a Watersports Center.
Transport from Red Sea International Airport to the hotel is included in the room rate.

highlights.text: Jiwa Beach Club is a Bali beach club-inspired seaside venue serving Southeast Asian cuisine.
Jiwa Beach Club offers a hands-on Discovery class in Balinese cuisine and culture, plus sunset bonfires and Drum Sessions.
The Lobby offers an Aperi-Tea service with tea-based cocktails and small plates.
The spa has a Rejuvenation Area with indoor and outdoor plunge pools, infrared and bio saunas, a snow shower and heated loungers.
The gym offers open-water swims and Aquafit board classes.

considerations.text: The drive from Jeddah airport takes approximately six hours.
WhataHotel notes the remote island location requires additional travel arrangements.
